quote: True genesis is not at the beginning but at the end.
source: Ernst Bloch, The Principle of Hope, ch. 55, closing paragraph, first clause (trans. Neville Plaice, Stephen Plaice and Paul Knight, 1986)

reason: Independent quotations agree on the full sentence: True genesis is not at the beginning but at the end, and it starts to begin only when society and existence become radical, i.e. grasp their roots.
